summary: Sprint B Dev-3 done. Migration 0006 adds orders, order_items, dispatches (truck/container + 8-key export_checklist) and payments (append-only). All four are function-only: SELECT by org, no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE grant, writes only through 7 SECURITY DEFINER functions (fn_quote_accept, fn_order_set_status, fn_order_set_packed, fn_order_dispatch, fn_dispatch_tick, fn_dispatch_delivered, fn_payment_record). Each one has SET search_path, checks fn_current_org() and fn_require_module, and raises 42501 / P0001 by the contract. 0006 also adds the security_invoker views v_orders_in_production, v_order_balances (Paid/Waiting/Late), v_money_due and v_home_kpis (always one row). Seed 04 loads exactly the sample-data orders, items, 2 dispatches and 4 payments and bumps the ORD/PI/INV/SDN/REC counters. As the demo owner, v_home_kpis shows the acceptance numbers 2 / 1 / 1 / Rs 5,11,875 + $18,900 / about Rs 21,04,200 / 1 late / 5 to do. Screens: Orders list, order detail with the Plant packing card, dispatch form, export checklist, print PI / invoice / slip, Money list, Money received, Products. Home now shows the 'about Rs' line. tests/orders-payments.test.ts has 22 tests. All checks pass.

contract_deviations: fn_quote_accept: follows contract 4.4 rather than the task text. A stored 'expired' quote, or a sent quote whose valid_till has passed, raises quote_expired (P0001). Rejected or accepted quotes raise invalid_transition. A quote with no items raises no_items. A NULL or out-of-range advance % raises bad_payload.

Error codes the contract leaves open: fn_payment_record on a cancelled order raises invalid_transition (P0001). fn_dispatch_tick on a truck dispatch, an unknown key or NULL done raises bad_payload. fn_order_set_status with an unknown status code raises bad_payload.
fn_order_dispatch: p_bags NULL defaults to orders.packed_bags. Vehicle and container numbers are trimmed and upper-cased. Container-only fields are stored as NULL for truck mode.

v_order_balances adds 4 columns after the contract's list: payment_terms, phone (primary contact), latest_invoice_no and created_at, for the Money list and the WhatsApp reminder. v_money_due.phone comes from that column.

New helper fn_format_money(amount, currency) builds the amount text in the system follow-up notes ('$18,900', 'Rs 5,11,875' with the rupee sign). It is IMMUTABLE and not SECURITY DEFINER, so it needs no allowlist entry.
Extra constraints and index not in the contract: CHECK currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' on orders and payments, CHECK dispatched_kg >= 0, and an index on orders (org_id, quotation_id).

Seed 04 resets the story on every run: it deletes non-seed payments, dispatches and items on the three seeded orders (ORD-0001..0003) before upserting. Orders created during a demo (ORD-0004 and later) are kept.

Print routes follow screens.md: /orders/[id]/print/pi, /print/invoice and /print/slip, all served by one page (print/[doc]). The contract 6.1 form /orders/[id]/print?doc=pi|invoice|sdn&dispatch= redirects to them.
The orders and payments ActionResult adds an optional `code` on success (the invoice or receipt number). It is a superset of the contract 6.2 type.
Money list: added a 'To collect' chip for ?filter=due (Late + Waiting), between All and Late / Waiting / Paid.
The order detail stepper shows no per-step dates (StatusStepper has no date prop, and audit_log is readable only with the audit module). It shows 'since <status_changed_at>' instead.
open_issues: /payments/[id] and the receipt print (print)/payments/[id]/print are listed under Dev-3 in contracts 6.1 but are not built. The task deliverables and screens.md 21-22 do not need them; the success screen offers 'Share receipt on WhatsApp' instead.

No authenticated UI verification. There is no Supabase stack and no hosted credentials, so pages were checked by typecheck, build and unauthenticated 307 -> /login only. All page reads are single-table PostgREST selects with no embedding, to keep the risk low.
Partial dispatch is not supported in the UI: fn_order_dispatch moves the order to dispatched, so a second dispatch is refused. This matches contract 4.4 and the demo scope.
The 'demo seed' Vitest case re-runs seeds 02-04 inside a rolled-back transaction. It skips itself when the demo org already has rows that a demo run added (ORD-0004+, INQ-0011+, QTN-0005+).
next build was run in the shared tree, so .next now holds my build output.

Role walls to try: Sales sees Money numbers but no 'Money received' button. Only the owner sees 'Cancel order' (under More, before dispatch). Plant cannot untick or tick phyto/coo, cannot mark Delivered, and gets /access-denied on /print/pi and /print/invoice but can print the slip.
Products: owner and accountant see a lock icon with the cost per kg (from v_product_costs). Sales and Plant see no cost, and the query is not even run for them.
Raw-code check: ports Pipavav / Mundra are proper nouns. Statuses, modes, pay modes and checklist keys always go through labels. Printed papers are English only.
notes_for_other_devs: dev2: /quotes/[id]/accept already calls fn_quote_accept with the contract parameter names. The order page now shows the msg.order_created toast when it opens with ?from_quote=<id> (your redirect), so you need no change. Accept errors: quote_expired / invalid_transition / no_items / bad_payload (P0001); module or cross-org is 42501.

dev1: v_order_balances and v_money_due keep the contract column names your buyer page reads (due, days_overdue, money_status, due_date, total_due, max_days_overdue). v_order_balances adds payment_terms, phone, latest_invoice_no and created_at at the end. Order follow-ups (entity_type 'order') always carry buyer_id, so v_followups_today shows the buyer name and phone.

dev2 (ci-tenant-check owner): there are no new SECURITY DEFINER names. All 7 functions in 0006 were already in SECURITY_DEFINER_ALLOWLIST, and fn_format_money is a plain IMMUTABLE function. I did not touch scripts/ci-tenant-check.ts.

All: orders, order_items, dispatches and payments have no write grant for authenticated. Tests and seeds must insert them as postgres or through the functions. Delete children before orders when cleaning up: dispatches and payments reference orders ON DELETE RESTRICT.

findings.change: orders/helpers.ts isExportCountry(country) replaced by isExportBuyer({ buyer_type, country }): buyer_type export_* decides (isExportType from src/types/buyers.ts); with no type it falls back to the contract 6.3 rule country <> 'India' exactly as quotes/helpers.ts isExportBuyer reads it ('' = export, null = India, trimmed, case-insensitive). loadOrderDetail now selects buyers.buyer_type into OrderBuyerView. Call sites: /orders/[id] (container default, WhatsApp language, Money reminder), /orders/[id]/dispatch (Truck/Container default), /orders/[id]/print/[doc] (PI export layout, invoice title, WhatsApp language).
